Better than a Watch: The holovid from the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreQuikscell],company]] headquarters flickers and jitters. A clearly synthesised female voice talks over an image of a speaking, smiling woman whose mouth is very obviously not making the words you hear. "Hello, valued Sales Rep employee! We here at the {TGT_SYSTEM.name} branch of the QUIKSCELL COMPANY thank you for your ERROR years of dedication! As a token of our appreciation for your Sales Rep contribution to the QUIKSCELL COMPANY, we are legally mandat-- thrilled --to reward you with a QUIKSCELL COMPANY CARE PACKAGE! Please enjoy your mandate-- well earned --reward in your own time! Do not use company hours to appreciate the gift. Do not use company hours to inspect the gift. Do not look inside the gift. Do not..." Judging by the scrubber bar, the remaining two-thirds of the message are likely to be legalese. Probably safe to ignore it.
比看表强: 来自[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreQuikscell],公司]]总部的全息影像闪烁抖动。一名合成女声盖过了一个正在说话、面带微笑的女人影像，而她的嘴明显没有说出你听到的这些话。 “您好，尊贵的 销售代表 员工！ 我们谨代表 {TGT_SYSTEM.name} 星系的 QUIKSCELL 公司，感谢您为公司奉献了 错误 年！ 为了感谢您对 QUIKSCELL 公司的 销售代表 贡献，我们依法要求—— 诚挚地 ——奖励您一份 QUIKSCELL 公司礼品包！ 请在自己的时间里享用这份命令—— 来之不易的 ——奖励！请勿占用公司工时欣赏礼物。请勿占用公司工时检查礼物。请勿打开礼物。请勿……” 从进度条来看，剩下三分之二的内容大概都是法律条款。大概可以放心忽略。

Better than a Watch: As you arrive in the 'Mech Bay to inspect the goods - on company time, of course - Yang appears to be midway through the stages of grief. The pile of discarded tools and kicked-over crates of equipment at least tell you he went through anger before you got here. That's good. As you approach, he throws up his hands. "Look, I know we have to work for these guys, but come on!" He starts, incredulous. Perhaps he wasn't quite done with anger yet. "Hey. Just relax, Yang," you say, attempting to reassure him, "it could be worse. They could've just given us a gift card for fifty-percent off [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreTripleFBurger],Triple-F]] burgers or something." Wrong move. Yang throws down his plasma torch. "Yeah? I think I would've preferred that, Boss. Enjoy your corporate mandated coffin." As Yang storms off in a huff, you turn your eyes to the 'Mech in the bay.
比看表强: 你来到“机甲库”检查货物——当然，是在公司时间内——杨似乎正处于悲伤的几个阶段之间。散落的工具和被踢翻的设备箱至少说明，在你来之前他已经经历了愤怒阶段。很好。 你走近时，他举起双手。“听着，我知道我们得替这些家伙干活，但拜托！”他难以置信地说道。看来他还没完全走出愤怒阶段。 “嘿，放轻松，杨。”你试图安慰他，“情况本来可以更糟。他们本可以只给我们一张五折礼品卡，用来买[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreTripleFBurger],Triple-F]]汉堡之类的东西。” 这话说错了。杨扔下等离子割炬。“是吗？老板，我倒宁愿要那个。享受公司强制配发的棺材吧。” 杨怒气冲冲地走开后，你把目光转向机库里的那台机甲。
